stem:

stem: Which of the following is the busiest sea route of the world?
expl: North Atlantic Ocean Route is the busiest ocean route. Major ports of western Europe i.e., London, Liverpool, Hamburg, Amsterdam etc. and major ports of North America like Quebec, New York, Boston, Philadelphia etc. come under the North Atlantic Ocean Route.

stem: Which one of the following is the busiest ocean trade route ?

stem:

1. Rhine river is an important pathway for industrial activity in northern Germany.
2. Port of Rotterdam is located at the mouth of the Rhine river.
Select the correct answer using the code given below :
Code :
expl: The Rhine river flows from the Swiss Alps through the rift valley and empties in to the North Sea. The famous city of Bonn in Germany is situated on its banks. It flows from Germany. The Rhine River is an important pathway for Industrial activities in Western and Southern Germany, therefore statement 1 is wrong. The port of Rotterdam is located in the delta of the Rhine - Meuse - Scheldt rivers in the Netherlands.

stem: The given map shows locations of airports labelled as 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5. What is the correct sequences of the airports in which the hijacked Indian Airlines plane IC-814 landed after its initial take off from Kathmandu in December 1999?
expl: The Indian airlines plane IC-814, which was hijacked after its initial take off from Kathmandu in December 1999, landed at Amritsar airport marked "5" in the map, then in Lahore marked "4" in the map, then in Dubai marked "2" in the map and finally landed at Kandahar airport marked "3" in the map.

stem:
Match List- I with List- II and select the correct answer using the codes given below:
List- I List II
(A) European trans- (1) Paris to Istanbul Continental railway
(B) Trans-Andean railway (2) Leningrad to Vladivostok
(C)Trans-Siberian railway (3) Leningrad to Volgograd
(D)Orient Express (4) Buenos Aires to Valparaiso
(5) Paris to Warsaw
Code : A B C D
expl: European trans-continental railway travel from Paris to Warsaw. Trans-Andean railway is the most important rail route of South America. It travels from Valparaiso to Buenos Aires of Argentina. The Trans-Siberian railway is the longest (about 9300 km.) railway in the world. It has connects St. Petersberg (Leningrad) with Vladivostok. Note- The main track of Trans-Siberian Railway extends from Vladivostok to Moscow. By using a connecting service it can be traveled to Saint Petersburg in west. Orient Express was most important rail route of Europe. It runs across eight countries of Europe. It connects Paris & Le Havre to Istanbul.

stem: Which one of the following cities is not located on the Trans-Siberian rail route?
expl: Main cities located on the Trans-Siberian rail route from west to east are St. Petersburg, Moscow, Perm, Kazan, Yekaterin-burg, Tyumen, Omsk, Novosibirsk, Krasnoyarsk, Ulan-Ude, Chita, Khabarovsk and Vladivostok. Note- The main track of Trans-Siberian Railway extends from Vladivostok to Moscow. By using a connecting service it can be traveled to Saint Petersburg in west. The city not on trans-Siberian rail route is Sochi. So, the correct answer is option (c).

stem: Which country has the world's longest network of bullet train?
expl: The total length of China's operating high operating rail tracks reached 48000 km by the end of 2024. China has the largest high-speed rail network in the world. China has started its longest Bullet train. 'Shangri-la of the World' on 5 January, 2017 connecting Kunming, capital of South-west China's Yunnan Province to Beijing (2760 km) covering the distance in approximately 13 hours with the maximum speed of 330 km/h).
